description: This file defines macros, function prototypes, and external references related to whitespace rules management, likely used within version control or code formatting tools.

methods.name: unsigned whitespace_rule(struct index_state *, const char *)
methods.description: Calculates the whitespace rule for a given index state and string.

methods.name: unsigned parse_whitespace_rule(const char *)
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a whitespace rule value.

methods.name: unsigned ws_check(const char *line, int len, unsigned ws_rule)
methods.description: Checks a line against a whitespace rule.

methods.name: void ws_check_emit(const char *line, int len, unsigned ws_rule, FILE *stream, const char *set, const char *reset, const char *ws)
methods.description: Emits a whitespace check result to a stream with specified set/reset strings.

methods.name: char *whitespace_error_string(unsigned ws)
methods.description: Returns a string describing the whitespace error based on the rule.

methods.name: void ws_fix_copy(struct strbuf *, const char *, int, unsigned, int *)
methods.description: Fixes whitespace in a line and copies it to a strbuf.

methods.name: int ws_blank_line(const char *line, int len)
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: int ws_tab_width(rule)
methods.description: Extracts the tab width setting from a whitespace rule.
